refinementRequirements.dirtySnapshot: Separate parent commit from dirty working-copy digest. Changed bytes require local content receipt; parent commit remote URL is context only.
refinementRequirements.idempotency: sourceConnectionId + canonicalRepositoryId + exactSnapshotDigest + toolVersion + artifactDigest; display aliases and retries are not identity.
refinementRequirements.claimVerification: Source existence/version resolution plus semantic supportAssessment and VerificationReceipt. supported/partial/contradicted/unresolved remain visible.
refinementRequirements.offlineAuthorization: Owned local content uses local policy. Remote-private content is unavailable offline by default; an optional signed lease must bind current actor/workspace/scope and expire fail-closed. Immediate remote revocation while disconnected is not observable: record the exposure window; reconnect invalidates/rechecks authorization. Same resolver gates search, wiki, graph and agent reads.

contractPolicies.oneWriter: Each proposed path is owned by its package. Shared existing files require dependency-ordered edits or a lead integration writer; no concurrent writers. Package owner must be assigned before execution.
contractPolicies.authorization: Authenticated actor/workspace/source policy checked at every read/write/job boundary; local-owned vs remote-private offline policy from refinementRequirements.
contractPolicies.persistence: All table/record names below are proposed workspace-scoped persistence contracts, not existing ROX DB facts; storage migration and rollback belong to implementation.
contractPolicies.events: Names below are proposed typed events; payloads use authorized refs and monotonic run/index revision, not raw source/secrets.
contractPolicies.realtimeOffline: Use one scope/freshness/lease resolver for UI, jobs, wiki, graph and agents. Stale status survives restart; reconnect invalidates remote authorization. No remote-private offline content by default.
contractPolicies.cloudGate: Research artifacts do not launch workers/install/providers. Future cloud execution needs a baseline-specific checkout, actual owner, dependencies implemented, bounded source policy, version-pinned adapter and relevant checks. Private source/model egress requires the task-authorized policy and credential reference.

providers.name: OpenWiki
providers.selection: Assumption: this primary repository is the requested OpenWiki reference; keep provider-neutral RepoWiki contract if the intended product differs.
pipeline: Resolve Git root and source fingerprint
Begin init/update run and normalize full page plan
Assign next page; inspect code and reconcile atomic claims
Persist page completion and run checkpoint
Finish only when required page work and drift validation pass
Read/search versioned sections without a model call

security.outbound: Generation/retrieval-with-model can send selected source/wiki context to configured model provider; read-only local tools do not need a model.
security.credentials: Provider configuration belongs outside generated artifacts; credential paths and all logs need implementation-time verification.
security.telemetry: Source supports OPENWIKI_TELEMETRY_DISABLED / DO_NOT_TRACK; choose explicit opt-out for source-processing adapter.
security.instructionPolicy: Repository INSTRUCTIONS/AGENTS content is scoped input and must not override ROX/operator policy.

limitations: No package execution, generation, performance or installed-provider test performed.
Source code and tests are authoritative; claims may become stale despite readable pages.
WikiGraph edges are Markdown links, not dependencies or calls.
Generation-managed page replacement requires staged ownership; never redirect wiki output onto user-authored documents.

providers.name: GitDiagram
pipeline: Fetch repository metadata/default branch/tree/README within limits
Select bounded code excerpts and import/name reference evidence
Verify source content with Git blob identity; reject invalid/truncated context
Generate overview and structured architecture graph
Validate schema, node/group IDs, paths and edge references; refine evidence citations
Compile escaped Mermaid; sanitize directives/SVG/links in renderer
Persist result and audit under public/private storage policy

integrationSurfaces.contract: internal application endpoints, no stable SDK claim

security.outbound: Selected repository content is sent to AI provider. Hosting/storage and GitHub credentials are separate exposure boundaries.
security.render: Source strips Mermaid configuration and unsafe click directives, sanitizes SVG and allows only HTTPS github.com links.
security.privateRepoPolicy: Source text describes protected browser cookie for 30 days and private artifact storage. No independent deployed security audit or private request was performed.

limitations: Generated architecture is interpretive. Source path/import support improves citations but does not prove arbitrary model edge labels or complete call topology.
The full hosted application is not a drop-in local ROX library.
Optional video infrastructure is outside minimum Code Intelligence planning scope.
Default branch/HEAD links must be rewritten to captured commit/blob identity for ROX citations.

providers.name: Groma
pipeline: Discover configured scanner and verify readiness
Read selected files under canonical repository scope
Collect roots/files/source units/operations/invocations/HTTP evidence and diagnostics
Reconcile deterministic observations with authored identity/ownership and metadata
Persist C4 elements/selected relationships in OKF 0.2 Markdown
Render annotated architecture and stage agent curation through Groma structural commands

integrationSurfaces.contract: experimental source-versioned; no promised stable API

security.outbound: Core scan is local and does not call an AI service. A curating host agent has its own source-to-model exposure.
security.instructions: Initializer updates managed groma blocks in existing AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md; realpath deduplication prevents duplicate linked targets. ROX must stage/preview these changes, preserve user text, and avoid automatic external instruction installation.

limitations: No Groma init/scan/web run was performed in the ROX checkout. Existing historic installation does not establish current ROX coverage.
draft/stable is an authored lifecycle state, not verified/unverified confidence.
Raw scanner operations/call evidence are ephemeral, not a persistent full call graph.
Language/framework coverage must be checked against the actual repository and scanner readiness.

providers.name: Repogrep.com

integrationSurfaces.contract: manual external link only until documented API/terms verified

security.outbound: Public client text describes private-chat token forwarding; backend retention, access enforcement and provider chains are unknown.
security.tested: Only public GET HTML/assets were fetched. No account login, AI query, private repository, token submission or UI interaction executed.

limitations: No public source repository or product license was verified.
Website asset endpoint shape is deployment-specific and not a stable API contract.
Source links can refer to HEAD, which is unsuitable for reproducible evidence without a captured revision.
Different products named Repogrep do not establish capabilities for repogrep.com.

providers.name: Zoekt

security.outbound: Self-hosted search can remain local; external exposure, auth and repository ACL must be configured by ROX/operator.

limitations: Optional capacity spike only. No binary installation, indexing, auth layer, benchmark or production integration was tested.
An index service needs operational ownership and commit freshness/ACL mapping.

alternatives.name: ROX local source index + rg
alternatives.why: Reuses the verified source-index facade and existing workspace boundaries; precise code queries remain local and work without hosted model/provider access.
costs: Add repository-aware snapshot and query contracts
Existing TS bounds must be surfaced rather than silently omitted
alternatives.fallback: Bounded rg CLI adapter with argv input and canonical root; no shell interpolation

alternatives.name: Supported external provider adapter + external Repogrep link
alternatives.why: A documented provider API can add hosted/multi-repository capabilities while keeping an explicit source exposure policy. Repogrep is currently only a manual external reference.
outputs: captured source revision or clearly unpinned result
alternatives.gate: No direct use of the bundled /api/v1/repogrep/search until primary public API and terms are verified

alternatives.name: Self-hosted Zoekt search
alternatives.why: Official source documents a local repository index and JSON/gRPC search surfaces. It is a distinct capacity path when rg/FTS limits become concrete.
outputs: bounded search hits and index snapshot metadata
risks: Search ACL leakage if repo scopes are not enforced
alternatives.gate: Compare against real local corpus and expected query load before introducing service dependency

entities.name: RepositoryBinding
entities.semantics: Project identity is distinct from repository/path; one project may bind several repos.

entities.name: RepositorySnapshot
entities.semantics: Clean snapshot can use commit-pinned remote source. Dirty working-copy bytes have a separate digest and local receipt; parent commit URL is not an exact citation for changed bytes.

entities.name: SourceFile
entities.semantics: Repository-relative normalized path; immutable content version.

entities.name: FileSpan
entities.semantics: Inclusive 1-based lines; verify current hash before opening/applying.

entities.name: CodeSymbol
entities.semantics: Deterministic scanner result; absence of scanner support is explicit.

entities.name: DependencyEvidence
entities.semantics: Import/call/HTTP evidence is typed; unresolved edges remain unresolved.

entities.name: SearchIndex
entities.semantics: No implicit guarantee that content index equals full source coverage.

entities.name: SearchQuery
entities.semantics: Scope assigned from caller authority; mode literal/regex/text/symbol declares semantics.

entities.name: SearchHit
entities.semantics: Hit with evidence ref, not a model assertion.

entities.name: IntelligenceRun
entities.semantics: Queued/running/cancelling/cancelled/failed/completed/stale states are separate from artifact review.

entities.name: GeneratedArtifact
entities.semantics: Key = source connection + canonical repository + exact snapshot + tool version + artifact digest; aliases or repeated runs do not duplicate the same wiki artifact. One writer per output namespace.

entities.name: GraphNode
entities.semantics: Kinds separate source symbol/file from AI summary and C4 concept.

entities.name: GraphEdge
entities.semantics: Trust deterministic-supported/authored/model-proposed/unsupported; not Groma stable/draft.

entities.name: WikiPage
entities.semantics: Generated repo wiki and user-authored knowledge page have separate ownership.

entities.name: WikiSection
entities.semantics: Section reference returns complete bounded context or explicit limit error.

entities.name: Claim
entities.semantics: Atomic statement; current/stale/missing/retracted assessment derives from evidence versions.

entities.name: EvidenceRef
entities.semantics: Resolver verifies source version, then semantic support assessment records supported/partial/contradicted/unresolved with a receipt. File or URL existence alone does not verify the claim.

entities.name: C4Element
entities.semantics: Groma C4 actor/system/container/component; source ownership and lifecycle retain provider semantics.

entities.name: ReviewProposal
entities.semantics: Human/navigator apply boundary and source fingerprint validation remain explicit.

entities.name: ProviderPolicy
entities.semantics: Owned local repositories follow local policy. Remote-private default denies offline content; optional actor/workspace-scoped signed lease expires fail-closed. Reconnect invalidates cached authorization.

entities.name: InstructionPatch
entities.semantics: Managed-marker-only instructions update; preserve unrelated bytes and authoritative policy.

entities.name: VerificationReceipt
entities.semantics: Receipt proves what source was read and how it supports, partially supports or contradicts the proposition; unresolved is allowed. URL/path availability alone is not semantic verification.

screens.name: Project / Code Intelligence Overview
screens.entry: ProjectInfoPage tab and authorized project route
screens.interaction: Focus begins at heading; tab buttons keyboard reachable; provider/freshness hints on hover, focus and click; exact shortcut bindings are design decisions.

screens.name: Code Search
screens.entry: Overview Search tab or SourceInfoPage action
screens.interaction: Enter submits query; Escape cancels or closes local popover; up/down selects result only within focused list; search box never consumes global app shortcuts.

screens.name: Source File / Evidence
screens.entry: Search hit, wiki citation or graph evidence
screens.interaction: Line anchors keyboard focusable; evidence hint explains resolver and version; local open validates canonical path and permission.

screens.name: Architecture Graph
screens.interaction: Keyboard outline provides node/edge navigation without canvas; hover/focus/click show type, source, trust and freshness; reduced motion and graph layout persistence planned.

screens.name: RepoWiki / Page / Section
screens.entry: Overview RepoWiki tab or KnowledgeNavigator provider
screens.interaction: Headings and ToC focusable; link graph means page link only; generated content labeled with provider/source snapshot.

screens.name: Run Detail
screens.entry: Overview Runs tab or agent task attachment
screens.interaction: Progress changes announced accessibly; cancel requires idempotent server boundary; completed means run finished, not applied.

screens.name: Artifact Review / Apply
screens.interaction: Apply keyboard reachable with explicit target files; review does not auto-apply; unknown base hash disables apply with concrete reason.

screens.name: Provider / Repository Policy
screens.interaction: Secrets entered through existing secure credential flow; help explains provider exposure and exact scope; no raw credentials in overview or artifacts.

sources.title: langchain-ai/openwiki: README.md
claims: Repository wiki generation and update, linking/workspace navigation, CLI visualization and host-agent integrations are documented. Personal mode and repository mode have different ingestion and generation workflows.

sources.title: langchain-ai/openwiki: package.json
claims: Package version 0.6.1; Node >=22.22.0; CLI entry dist/cli/cli.js; MCP, DeepAgents and model provider dependencies.

sources.title: langchain-ai/openwiki: LICENSE
claims: The frozen source has an MIT license.

sources.title: langchain-ai/openwiki: AGENTS.md
claims: Generated wiki provides optional just-in-time context. Source code and tests remain authoritative; generated pages are not edited manually during source changes.

sources.title: langchain-ai/openwiki: src/claims/core/types.ts
claims: Claim id and statement have versioned resource evidence; add, confirm, update and retract are separate reconciliation operations. Proposed evidence does not carry a model-supplied version.

sources.title: langchain-ai/openwiki: src/claims/brains/code/store.ts
claims: Code claim persistence validates canonical identifiers and uses filesystem security helpers.

sources.title: langchain-ai/openwiki: src/generation/page-jobs.ts
claims: Page plans normalize purposes, seed paths, related pages and per-page claim reconciliation.

sources.title: langchain-ai/openwiki: src/generation/run-state.ts
claims: Schema version 1 checkpoint .run.json stores runId, planning/generating phase, sourceFingerprint and ordered page jobs with pending/skipped/complete states.

sources.title: langchain-ai/openwiki: src/generation/repository-run.ts
claims: Repository generation has durable begin/plan/page/finish lifecycle boundaries.

sources.title: langchain-ai/openwiki: src/integrations/mcp/server.ts
claims: Host integrations expose begin, submit_plan, next_page, submit_page, finish and page-claim inspection under MCP; generation and retrieval are separate surfaces.

sources.title: langchain-ai/openwiki: src/integrations/core/retrieval-tools.ts
claims: Read-only search/read/list tools have strict bounded inputs, canonical repository roots, workspace/wiki selectors and heading anchors.

sources.title: langchain-ai/openwiki: src/retrieval/wiki.ts
claims: Wiki retrieval returns ranked section references and reads selected complete heading sections.

sources.title: langchain-ai/openwiki: src/linking/wiki-workspaces.ts
claims: Linked repository wikis can be grouped into named workspaces.

sources.title: langchain-ai/openwiki: src/visualize/graph.ts
claims: WikiGraph is a directed page-link graph with WikiNode and WikiEdge, not a source call graph.

sources.title: langchain-ai/openwiki: src/telemetry/gates.ts
claims: OPENWIKI_TELEMETRY_DISABLED and DO_NOT_TRACK can opt out. CI execution is tagged and is not automatically an opt-out.

sources.title: ahmedkhaleel2004/gitdiagram: README.md
claims: Current GitDiagram offers interactive generated repository diagrams, exports and optional video explainer functionality.

sources.title: ahmedkhaleel2004/gitdiagram: LICENSE
claims: The frozen source has an MIT license.

sources.title: ahmedkhaleel2004/gitdiagram: docs/architecture.md
claims: Current backend is Next.js route handlers, with source context, structured graph validation, Mermaid compilation, Redis coordination and R2 persistence.

sources.title: ahmedkhaleel2004/gitdiagram: src/app/api/generate/stream/route.ts
claims: Streaming generation route imports admission, cancellation, context, graph and persistence modules; runtime nodejs, maxDuration 300.

claims: Structured diagram schema defines groups, nodes, edges and optional edge evidencePath with explicit graph/label/path limits.

claims: Graph validation checks IDs, groups, edges and repository paths; missing evidence paths can be removed; GitHub links are compiled from owner/repo/branch/path.
